releaseTitle: Schedule Publish Candidate Repair and PWA Gate Hardening
notes: Loads Schedule Publish candidates from authoritative Firestore server reads before composing confirmed shift evidence, so local-only echoes or stale mobile cache rows cannot create a client/server candidate mismatch.
Keeps explicit open shifts publishable without forcing an employee match while maintaining the server closed-world candidate and fingerprint checks.

Changes the PWA browser icon matrix to validate app-shell HTML, manifest metadata, and icon bytes through Playwright request fixtures so an optional Firefox launch failure cannot block a metadata-only release-gate check.
